simple.meaning: גָּדָה (gâdâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a border of a river (as cut into by the stream).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Joshua 3:15. The surrounding context includes covenant, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּדָה (H1415) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גָּדָה (gâdâh) / H1415 is traced through Joshua 3:15, Joshua 4:18, 1 Chronicles 12:16, Isaiah 8:7 with generated occurrence evidence.

structuredEvidence.definition: a border of a river (as cut into by the stream)

firstOccurrence.englishText: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

timeline.evidenceText: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.
Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

definitions.short: a border of a river (as cut into by the stream)
definitions.full: H1415. gadah [ גָּדָה ] noun feminine bank of river (compare Arabic , id. , Aramaic גּוּדָּא , wall ), גְּדוֺתָיו Josh 3:15 ; 4:18 ; 1Chr 12:16 Qr (Kt גדיתיו ) Isa 8:7 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to cut off);
